## Remarks

`params = CONTENT & ROUTE`<!-- -->: the shared template content (`data`<!-- -->, `AGBaseId`<!-- -->, read from the `<g-venue>` block) on the forced-send route (`IRouteReply`<!-- -->), with the option slot narrowed to the `sendVenue` call (`IOptVenue`<!-- -->).
